method.derivation: Digest. Touchdown/Rushing/Receiving inherit eligibility from touchdown_radar, rb_spotlight and wr_spotlight and are re-ranked on the market-specific rate. Passing Yards is built here from _passer_metrics; no V1 concept produced it.
method.scoring_caveat: Each target is the largest rung the projection clears with probability >= p_target, under a lognormal fitted to the player's own mean and shrunk per-game spread. Where Kalshi lists the player, the rungs scanned are its REAL listed contracts and book_verified is true -- the reader can trade that exact number. Where it does not, the ladder is synthetic and book_verified is false: treat those as illustrative, because a number no exchange offers cannot be bet.

book_lines.source: Action Network web API (same as the NBA sheet)
book_lines.rule: lowest over line across DK/FD/MGM/Caesars/BetRivers/bet365/Fanatics/Hard Rock; ties to the better price

coverage.pass_yards: 30 players priced across 7 books (BetMGM, BetRivers, Caesars, DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics, bet365)
coverage.rush_yards: 85 players priced across 7 books (BetMGM, BetRivers, Caesars, DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics, bet365)
coverage.rec_yards: 186 players priced across 8 books (BetMGM, BetRivers, Caesars, DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics, Hard Rock, bet365)
coverage.anytime_td: 528 players priced across 7 books (BetMGM, Caesars, DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics, Hard Rock, bet365)

odds.source: Kalshi public market data (no auth required) -- fallback when Action Network has no line
odds.note: Coverage is partial and deepens as kickoff approaches. A player the exchange does not list falls back to the synthetic grid rather than being dropped.

method.started_games_note: Week 1 opens on a Wednesday, so by the Sunday run the Wed/Thu/Sat props are already settled. Players whose kickoff has passed are excluded outright.
method.distribution: lognormal by method of moments; Poisson for Anytime TD. scipy is not a dependency, so the survival function is math.erfc and the ladder is scanned rather than inverted.
method.backtest_note: Unlike the five V1 concepts, this sheet has not been measured against holdout weeks. Do not present its ordering as validated.

constraints.rookie_note: Inherited. Three of four categories take their pool from boards that already applied ROOKIE_ELIGIBLE_WEEK=3, so rookies cannot be admitted early without changing SpotlightConfig -- shared code the live sheets depend on. Only Passing Yards is gated here.
